name: CR Newly Incorporated Local Companies (weekly CSV)
note: Open CR weekly CSV: newly incorporated LOCAL companies + name changes. Fields: Seq, English name, Chinese name, BR Number, Date of Incorporation, Date of Change of name. Date DD-MM-YYYY. No personal data. Enumerate weekly file dates via the data.gov.hk CKAN API.

name: CR Newly Registered Non-HK Companies (weekly CSV)
note: Open CR weekly CSV: newly registered NON-HONG-KONG companies + name changes. Fields: Seq, Corporate Name, Approved HK Name, BR Number, Date of Registration, Date of Change of name.

name: data.gov.hk CKAN — CR newly-registered dataset
note: CKAN catalog. Use to enumerate the weekly RNC063L/RNC063F resource URLs (one per week) for the CR open dataset.
